venues.how_to_get_the_food_prices_that_are_miss: Download the Komida app (iOS id1356304936 / Android pro.komida). venues.price_honesty: Sliced's FOOD prices (including the oxtail pizza) are app-gated and NOT published anywhere on the open web — verified by checking their site, Komida's web presence, and menu aggregators. They are UNKNOWN here and must NOT be guessed. What IS recorded: the four verified happy-hour drink prices and the $2.50 slice figure from their own posts.

venues.name: 7-Eleven Thailand (any store)
venues.context: Jordan, 2026-10-15: *"I know 7-Eleven is almost everywhere, so we can make lessons on ordering certain items from 7-11. I know their 7-Eleven is different from ours."* He is right — the Thai store is a food business, not a snack aisle.
venues.source: cktravels.com '64 things you can buy in Thailand's 7-Eleven' + travelinstinctoz.com 'The 7-Eleven Phenomenon' (Jun 2026) + thai-awesome.com '10 new must-try 7-Eleven foods 2026'
venues.the_difference: THE store fact to know: your toastie is not ready to eat — **staff microwave it for you, for free**. That single request (เวฟให้หน่อย) is the most useful Thai sentence in the country.

items.item: Toastie / toasted sandwich (แซนด์วิช)
items.note: 50+ flavours and counting: cheese, carbonara danish, pandan custard, Milo Roti, plant-based pork. THE reason to go.
Refrigerated section, Kewpie mayo on milk bread. Sells out fast — go earlier in the day.
Chiller. Staff microwave it; packet has a sauce sachet and a small fork.
Microwavable meal, almost universal. Rated as good as street food.

items.item: Nata de coco / coconut jelly cup
items.note: Light and cold — the right call in the heat.

items.item: Bottled Thai milk tea / banana+chocolate milk
items.note: Mix the banana-caramel and chocolate milks for the local dessert-in-a-cup.
Thailand-only flavours. Don't buy blind if shellfish matters to you — nori versions can carry shrimp powder.
The ubiquitous 7-11 drink; everywhere on every trip report.

venues.name: La Miniera Pool Villas Pattaya
venues.address: 666 Moo 1, Chaiyapornvitee 14 Road, Nong Prue, Bang Lamung, Chonburi 20150 — ~2 h by road from Bangkok
venues.context: The villa from the Instagram reel Jordan found (nora_travellife, 2026-10-16). HQ identified it as La Miniera Pool Villas Pattaya and Jordan confirmed it: *"Thank you so much i found it."* It is the anchor of the Pattaya leg — and the reason the sentence pattern จาก X แค่ [time] ก็มี Y is worth owning.
venues.source: 00-HQ/pattaya-villa-identified-2026-10-16.md (TripAdvisor range, Agoda average, KAYAK 'from' + booking-lead finding); the property's own published tour video for the in-room pool + 2-hour-from-Bangkok claim
venues.the_difference: THE sentence to own is the one the reel itself used: จาก X แค่ [time] ก็มี Y — 'just [time] from X, and there's Y.' It describes ANY destination by distance + draw, so it survives every hotel, every town and every trip after this one. Learn the shape, not the sentence.

rates.note: Shoulder nights read as a steal at this price; Monday is the cheapest night (~$179 average).
The realistic band for a mid-week booking.
Sunday is the most expensive night of the week here — shift the stay if the dates are flexible.

Honest counterweight: at ~$250+ reviews are NOT uniformly glowing — one Agoda reviewer complained of a dirty in-room pool at >10,000 THB/night. The value case is the $150-180 shoulder, not the top end.
KAYAK's own data: ~17% cheaper than last-minute. For a late-January trip that means booking mid-November — which also falls OUTSIDE Jordan's Nov 28 - Dec 24 Amazon blackout.
